test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

After he l__et the cat out of the bag__ about the surprise party, it was no longer a secret.
solution: The correct answer is: **Reveal a confidential information.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Let the cat out of the bag**" is an idiom that means to reveal a secret or confidential information. (किसी गुप्त या गोपनीय जानकारी को प्रकट करना) • **Example**: *Sarah accidentally let the cat out of the bag when she revealed the surprise party plans to her brother.* • So, "reveal a confidential information" accurately conveys the meaning of the idiom in the sentence. Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Murmur in the ears**" means to speak softly or whisper something to someone. (किसी से धीरे से बोलना या फुसफुसा कर कुछ कहना) • "**Show off to his friends**" means to boast or impress one's friends with one's actions or possessions. (अपने कार्यों या संपत्ति से अपने दोस्तों पर घमंड करना या उन्हें प्रभावित करना) • "**Take the gifts and brag**" means to boast about receiving gifts. (उपहार प्राप्त करने के बारे में शेखी बघारना) 45:T97e, The correct answer is: **Enthusiasm**.
